question: Will Copernicus rank 2026 as the warmest year on record?
description: Resolves YES if the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) reports in its Global Climate Highlights 2026, expected in mid-January 2027, that 2026 was the warmest calendar year in its ERA5 record, alone or jointly with another year; otherwise NO. The year to beat is 2024. After October 2026, C3S called second place the most likely result. Trading closes when the year ends, at 00:00 UTC on January 1, 2027. Collateral: NEAR.
